scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter=@gtd/web run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter=@gtd/server run dev" "pnpm --filter=@gtd/web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules && rm -rf node_modules
